subject: Boot rooms and practical entrance storage
hook: A hallway bench gets sat on, kicked and dripped on every day. Watch how we build one to cope.
ig:
A hallway bench gets sat on, kicked and dripped on every day. Watch how we build one to cope.

Entrance furniture has one of the hardest jobs in the house. That shapes how we make it in our Hanley workshop:

- The top and sides are cut to fit the exact width of the hallway or alcove.
- Every exposed edge is sealed with ABS edging, which helps against knocks, scuffs and damp coats.
- Holes are drilled for drawer runners or lift-up storage, depending on what you need to hide.
- The carcass is assembled and checked here before it leaves, so it's never flat-pack.

Then our own team fits it, fixing it securely so it doesn't shift when someone drops onto it to unlace their boots.

Thinking about a bench for your hallway, porch or utility? Comment BENCH and we'll send you the link.
